one_liner: Container image registry and sharing platform for Docker images.

auth.auth_notes: Docker Hub API supports Password authentication, Personal Access Tokens (PAT), and Organization Access Tokens (OAT). You must use each authentication type with the Create access token route to obtain a bearer token.

access.access_notes: Docker Hub provides self-serve registration and API token creation. Subscription tiers (Personal, Pro, Team) affect available features.

api_surface.breadth_notes: REST API (v2-beta) covering repositories, tags, organizations, teams, invites, SCIM, audit logs, and access tokens.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: The Docker Hub MCP Server uses a Personal Access Token (PAT) for authentication. HUB_PAT_TOKEN environment variable required.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: The Docker Hub MCP Server is publicly available via Docker MCP Catalog and can be used by anyone with a Docker Hub account.

buildability_signal.notes: Official MCP server available. API is in v2-beta status but functional. Self-serve access with PAT authentication.

evidence.claim: Docker Hub provides REST API v2-beta with multiple auth methods
evidence.quote: Password, Personal Access Token (PAT), Organization Access Token (OAT)

evidence.claim: Official Docker Hub MCP server exists
evidence.quote: The Docker Hub MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that interfaces with Docker Hub APIs to make them accessible to LLMs.

evidence.claim: MCP server uses PAT authentication
evidence.quote: HUB_PAT_TOKEN: your_hub_pat_token

research_notes: Docker Hub has an official MCP server with PAT-based authentication. The API is in v2-beta but provides comprehensive coverage of Docker Hub features.

one_liner: Cloud-based continuous integration and delivery platform for automating software builds and deployments.

auth.auth_notes: CircleCI API supports Bearer Authentication (recommended), Circle-Token header, Basic Authentication (legacy), and Personal API tokens. OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration is also available.

access.access_notes: CircleCI provides self-serve registration and API token creation through the web interface.

api_surface.breadth_notes: REST API (v2) covering pipelines, workflows, jobs, contexts, insights, users, projects, and webhooks.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: The hosted CircleCI MCP server supports OAuth2 authentication or personal API tokens. The CLI MCP uses credentials from circleci auth login or CIRCLE_TOKEN environment variable.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: The hosted MCP server is available at https://mcp.circleci.com/v1/mcp. CircleCI runs it, so there is nothing to install locally.

buildability_signal.notes: Official MCP server available both as hosted service and CLI-built-in. Multiple authentication methods. Self-serve access.

evidence.claim: CircleCI provides REST API v2 with multiple auth methods

evidence.claim: Hosted MCP server supports OAuth2

research_notes: CircleCI offers both a hosted MCP server and a CLI-built-in MCP. The hosted server supports OAuth2 authentication, making it easy to integrate with AI tools.

one_liner: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, project management, and databases.

auth.auth_notes: A bearer token is required to interact with the Notion API. Use an installation access token from an internal connection, an OAuth access token from a public connection, or a personal access token.

access.access_notes: Notion provides self-serve registration. OAuth connections require user authorization. Workspace owners can manage MCP client access in Settings.

api_surface.breadth_notes: RESTful API covering pages, databases, blocks, users, comments, searches, and file uploads with cursor-based pagination.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: Notion MCP is a remote MCP server hosted by Notion. After you authorize a connection with OAuth, the MCP client can use Notion MCP tools to read and update content that you can access.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: Workspace owners can manage MCP client access in Settings -> Connections. Organization owners can also use the Admin API to list and revoke members' connections.

buildability_signal.notes: Official Notion MCP server available with OAuth-based authentication. Well-documented API with SDKs. Self-serve access with user authorization.

evidence.claim: Notion provides RESTful API with bearer token authentication

evidence.claim: Official Notion MCP server with OAuth
evidence.quote: Notion MCP is a remote MCP server hosted by Notion. After you authorize a connection with OAuth, the MCP client can use Notion MCP tools to read and update content that you can access.

evidence.claim: MCP server provides tools for AI agents
evidence.quote: We've introduced Notion MCP, a remote MCP server with the following improvements: Easy installation via standard OAuth. No need to fiddle with JSON or API tokens anymore. Powerful tools tailored to AI agents, including editing pages in Markdown.

one_liner: Cloud-based database platform with spreadsheet-like interface for building collaborative applications.

api_surface.breadth_notes: REST API covering bases, tables, records, fields, attachments, webhooks, and automations. Official JavaScript SDK available.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: Airtable MCP server supports OAuth (recommended for end-user connections) and Personal Access Tokens (PATs, recommended for CLI, scripts, and server-side setups).

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: The MCP server is available to all users on all plans. Enterprise users may need admin allowlisting for third-party integrations.

buildability_signal.notes: Official Airtable MCP server available with OAuth and PAT authentication. Well-documented API with official SDK. Self-serve access.

evidence.claim: Airtable provides REST API with official JavaScript SDK
evidence.quote: The Airtable API can be used to integrate your data in Airtable with any external system. The API closely follows REST semantics, uses JSON to encode objects.

evidence.claim: Official Airtable MCP server with OAuth and PAT
evidence.quote: Our MCP server supports two authentication methods: OAuth (recommended for end-user connections) and Personal Access Tokens (PATs, recommended for CLI, scripts, and server-side setups).

evidence.claim: MCP server available to all plans
